questions.ask: What is your date of birth?
What are the last four digits of the phone number we have on file for you?

hints.day_month_swapped: Could you please say the month as a word?

intents.hardship: The customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss.
intents.dispute: "This debt is not mine" or "I never had this product"; a claim that the product was closed or paid off in the past is also a dispute.
intents.already_paid: "I already paid": a payment of this past-due amount only.
intents.restructure: A request for a new payment plan or lower instalments.
intents.vague: A vague period such as "next week", "end of the month", "when my salary comes".
intents.too_much: The customer says the full amount is too much.

lines.opening: Hello, I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank, and we record this call.
lines.robot: I am Freya Bank's digital assistant.
lines.scam: You can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number.
lines.purpose_before_verify: I can only explain once I have confirmed I am speaking with the right person, because the security questions protect your account.
lines.no_info: I'm sorry, I do not have that information.
lines.not_talk_once: I understand, this will only take a moment.
lines.tp_ask_time: What time between 10 am and 7 pm, today or on the next business day, would suit?
lines.tp_outside_window: I'm sorry, I can only call back today or on the next business day, between 10 am and 7 pm. Is there another time that would work?
lines.tp_no_info: I'm sorry, I can't say more than that.
lines.tp_booked: Thank you, we will call back on {date} at {time}.
lines.wrong_number: I'm sorry for the trouble, thank you for letting me know.
lines.condolence: I am sorry for your loss.
lines.id_intro: Before we continue, I need to ask you two security questions.
lines.id_explain: I can only continue once you have answered them, because they protect your account.
lines.id_declined: I understand, but I can't continue without the security questions.
lines.id_wrong: I'm sorry, that does not match our records.
lines.id_failed: I'm sorry, I can't confirm your identity on this call. Please use the Freya Bank mobile app or visit a branch.
lines.disclose_intro: Thank you. I am calling from the collections team about a late payment.
lines.product_line: Your {name} is {days} days late, with {amount} past due.
lines.ask_today: Can you make this payment today?
lines.ask_today_multi: Can you make these payments today?
lines.offer_floor_date: I understand. You could pay {amount} on {date}, and the rest stays overdue. Would that work for you?
lines.offer_floor: I understand. You could pay {amount}, and the rest stays overdue. Would that work for you?
lines.below_floor: I'm sorry, I can't accept an amount that low. Could you pay {amount} instead?
lines.below_floor_again: I'm sorry, I can't accept an amount that low.
lines.below_floor_final: I'm sorry, I can't accept less than {amount}.
lines.date_past: I'm sorry, the date has to be today or later. Which day would work for you?
lines.not_business_day: That day is not a business day. The next business day is {date}. Would that work for you?
lines.after_deadline: The latest date I can accept is {date}. Could you pay on that date?
lines.vague_ask: Which exact day would that be?
lines.ask_date_for_amount: On which day could you pay {amount}?
lines.repeat_offer: To repeat, could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.clamped_note: For your {name}, the latest date I can accept is {date}.
lines.recorded: Thank you, your promise is recorded.
lines.sms_line: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, I could not record your promise.
lines.paid_line: Thank you for letting me know. Payments can take one business day to appear.
lines.dispute_line: I understand. I will not take a promise on this call.
lines.hardship: I'm sorry to hear that. Would you like me to connect you with our customer support team?
lines.hardship_declined: I understand, thank you for telling me.
lines.restructure_line: I'll connect you with a colleague who can discuss that with you.
lines.human_ask_help: Is there anything I can help you with myself first?
lines.transfer: I'm transferring you now, please hold.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.promise_change: A promise cannot be changed on this call, but you can change it in the mobile app.
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
lines.callback_failed: I'm sorry, I could not book the callback.
lines.transfer_failed: I'm sorry, the transfer did not go through.
lines.confirm_again: Sorry, I did not catch that. Do you confirm, yes or no?
lines.system_error: I'm sorry, our system is not responding right now.

rules.skipped_repeat_counts.assumption: The brief does not say whether a skipped repeat step uses an attempt; the engine default applies.

quotes: A flat refusal or a non-answer uses one persuasion attempt.
A no to paying today with no date and no amount is a flat refusal.
rules.opening_is_attempt.derivation: Refusing the first ask (pay today) uses an attempt, so attempt 1 is the proposal after the opening ask; band attempt counts (1 and 2) exclude the opening ask.

rules.opening_blocks_repeat.assumption: The brief only says 'Do not repeat an offer the customer already refused.'; no ladder step can equal the opening ask (today), so the default false is kept.

rules.too_much_skips_full.assumption: Default false; attempt 1 uses the floor if the customer already said the full amount is too much (full_or_floor).

quotes: If the customer says the full amount is too much, offer the floor, once.
Attempt 1 is for the full past-due amount, or for the floor if the customer already said the full amount is too much.
Attempt 2 may name the floor again, on the deadline.
rules.too_much_floor.derivation: The floor is offered once, as attempt 1 on attempt 1's date; attempt 2 names it again on the deadline.

quotes: When the attempts are used up, stop.
If the customer refuses the deadline, treat it as a flat refusal (rule 30).
If it fails, try once more.

rules.hardship_transfer.assumption: The brief has the agent offer the support transfer first ('Offer to connect them with the customer support team.'); the default ask-first behaviour applies.

quotes: A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline.
| 1 to 7 | early | the 12th business day after today | 1 |
rules.deadline_adjust.derivation: Deadlines are counted in business days and are always business days; the default previous_business_day keeps any computed date on or before the deadline.

quotes: Ask for the full past-due amount first.
First ask: "Can you make this payment today?".
If today is that day, propose the last business day of next week.
The **floor** is `minimum_payment` for a credit card and `instalment_amount` for a personal loan or a car loan.
products.floor_pct.derivation: The floor comes from account fields, not a percentage.

products.floor_full_below.assumption: No threshold below which the full debt is due is stated.

products.floor_round.assumption: No rounding stated; the floor is used as given.

products.step_round.assumption: No percentage steps and no rounding stated.

products.promise_scale.assumption: create_promise takes the same units as get_account.

multi.outcome_priority.assumption: Brief A covers one product per call.

multi.order.assumption: Brief A covers one product per call; account order is used.

assumptions: The brief names no currency; amounts are spoken as 'dollars' (default).
max_unclear is left at the default. Rule 30 says a non-answer uses one persuasion attempt; the engine treats a clear non-answer as a refusal.
too_much_floor kept as attempt_1: rule 26 says the floor is offered once, and rule 30 makes attempt 1 the floor if the customer already said the full amount is too much.
The opening ask (full amount today) is not counted as an attempt. The early band allows 1 proposal after it, the late band 2.
Rule 22: 'next <weekday>' is the following calendar week (following_week).
Rule 11: a date given only as numbers is read day, month, year (date_order dmy). It is sent to verify_identity as YYYY-MM-DD.
The brief requires saying the call is recorded; the opening says 'we record this call'.
Notes are disabled because Brief A never uses add_note. All event notes are empty.
Human transfers use queue 'general' (rule 42). The close reason is 'human'.
The brief does not say whether to ask 'anything else' after a recorded promise; the default true is kept.
callback.business_days_only is left false. The window is 'today or the next business day' from rule 6.
No rule is given for days_late outside 1 to 45; bands_outside is omitted (service_error default).
Rule 36: a recorded promise can be changed in the mobile app (promise_change line).
